review.posthog_relevance: Adds team-scoped filtering to report lookups, potentially preventing cross-team data leakage and unnecessary database scans.
review.reason: Adds an optional `team_id` parameter to the report lookup and propagates the current team's ID to the filter. This establishes the mechanism for team-scoped queries. However, the tier is capped at 2 because the actual implementation of the team-scoped subquery and the caller's team ID propagation are not present in this chunk, leaving the correctness and performance benefit unpro.
